# GalleryPicker

**Class:** `UltraCanvasGalleryPicker` · **Group:** [Buttons and choices](../Groups/Buttons-and-choices.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasGalleryPicker.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasGalleryPicker.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasGalleryPicker.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Pick one of many choices shown as live pictures in titled sections - a chart gallery, styles, templates: a click or the arrow keys pick a tile, Enter takes it; tall content scrolls in its container

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasGalleryPicker(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(int)> onSelectionChanged` | a click or a key moved the pick |
| `onItemActivated` | `std::function<void(int)> onItemActivated` | double click, Enter |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### struct `GalleryPickerItem`

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | `std::string title` | under the picture |
| `description` | `std::string description` | the caller shows it (a tooltip, a line under the gallery) |
| `section` | `std::string section` | the heading it is shown under; consecutive items share one |
| `picture` | `std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasUIElement> picture` | drawn in the tile at the tile's picture size; may be null |
| `faded` | `bool faded = false` | the picture drawn lighter (an example, not the real data) |
